case_title: IMHOFF, ROBERT A. vs. ALSOUFI, MOHAMMED ABDULLAH et al

docket_entries.description: TRIAL ASSIGNED TO DEPARTMENT 06
#6 JUDGE:D.LITTLE; S.SAWYER/CSR;GVANHEST/CLERK. C/C FOR JURY TRIAL. CASE SETTLED AND A STIPULATION FOR JUDGMENT READ INTO THE RECORD. PLTF TO PREPARE JUDGMENT PURS. TO STIP.

DEPT 1/JUDGE MASON: C/C FOR JURY TRIAL. DEFT M.ALSOUFI APPEARED IN PRO-PER WITHOUT ARABIC TRANSLATOR. DEFT DID NOT HAVE PREPARED JURY INSTRUCTIONS AT TRIAL CALL. DEFT ADMONISHED THAT IF THEY ARE NOT PROVIDED TO TRIAL JUDGE WHEN REQUESTED, THAT JUDGE MAY STRIKE DEFT'S JURY DEMAND. DUE TO DEFT'S DIFFICULTY WITH COMMUNICATING IN ENGLISH, IT IS UNCLEAR WHETHER OR NOT DEFT UNDERSTOOD THIS. PLTF WAIVED ANY OBJECTIONS TO SETTLEMENT JUDGE ALSO ACTING AS TRIAL JUDGE. DEFT APPEARED TO UNDERSTAND THIS AND RAISED NO OBJECTION.

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT ALSOUFI, MOHAMMED ABDULLAH THE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES: 641 O'FARRELL STREET #111, SAN FRANCISCO, CA $1,000.00 RENT, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,000.00, STAYED UNTIL MAR-25-1997, LEASE FORFEITED, STAY OF EVICTION THRU 5PM ON 3/25/97. IF DFT DOES NOT VACATE TIMELY, PLTF ENTITLED TO AMENDED JUDGMNT FOR BACK RENT & DMGS OF $2119.64 & $113 COSTS. IF PREM. LEFT IN BROOM-CLEAN COND & KEYS RETURNED, PLTF TO APPLY SEC. DEPOSIT OF $350 TO $1000 MONEY JUDGMNT. SEE JUDGMNT FOR ADDITIONAL TERMS/CONDS.
